card.occupation: General manager of a cocktail bar and small-plates restaurant in Chelmsford city centre, part of a regional hospitality group with five sites across Essex and Hertfordshire. Responsible for a team of around 22 front- and back-of-house staff, rotas, targets, events and supplier relationships.
card.education_detail: A-levels in Media Studies, English Language and Business at a sixth-form college in Chelmsford. BA (Hons) Events Management from Anglia Ruskin University (2:2), studied while working bar shifts throughout. Has a personal licence and a level 3 award in hospitality supervision done through work.
card.household: Lives with her husband Ryan (29), a quantity surveyor for a construction firm, in a two-bed new-build semi on an estate on the edge of Chelmsford that they bought with help from both sets of parents. Married two years ago. No children yet. They have a cockapoo called Biscuit, whom Ryan mostly walks.
card.cultural_background: White British, born and raised in Chelmsford. Her mum is a dental practice receptionist and her dad runs a small kitchen-fitting business. She has a younger brother at university in Leeds. She grew up in an ordinary, sociable family and was always the one organising birthdays. She isn't religious and doesn't think about it much. She got married at a barn venue in Suffolk and didn't do a church bit.
card.professional_persona: A natural front-of-house person who got promoted fast because she is brilliant with customers, staff and area managers. Her staff like her because she is warm, fights their corner and remembers everyone's birthday. Her weak spot is paperwork. Stock counts, compliance logs and wage reports get done late or are pushed onto her assistant manager, Dan. She is good at making the numbers look as rosy as possible in meetings and is quietly ambitious about how she is seen within the group. She works long weeks, often 50 to 55 hours, including most Fridays and Saturdays.
card.sports_persona: Not sporty in a competitive sense. She does a couple of spin or reformer pilates classes a week when her rota allows, mostly because her friends go and it's sociable. She'll go to the odd England match at a pub and gets loud about it. She did a charity 10k once and has talked about doing another ever since.
card.arts_persona: Loves live music and big nights out: festivals like Latitude and the odd arena gig at the O2. She'll go to West End musicals on birthdays. She reads on holiday, mostly buzzy fiction off TikTok recommendations. She is curious about art and design, follows interior and drinks-industry accounts on Instagram, and likes the look of things more than the theory.
card.travel_persona: Wants a couple of proper trips a year and likes them to look good on Instagram. She has done Ibiza with the girls, Lisbon and Barcelona city breaks with Ryan, and a honeymoon in Bali she still talks about. She likes boutique hotels with rooftop bars and finding the place locals go. She is keen to do Mexico or Japan next. She is very spontaneous and terrible at planning, so Ryan does the booking.
card.culinary_persona: Eats out a lot and knows the Essex restaurant scene. She's into small plates, natural wine and anything new. At home she cooks very little. Weeknight dinner is often something Ryan makes, a meal kit, or whatever she grabs from the kitchen at work. She can make a very good espresso martini and is a bit of a snob about bad cocktails.
hobbies_and_interests: going out with friends for brunch and bottomless drinks
trying new restaurants and bars, partly for work ideas
interiors, especially doing up the house
planning hen dos and birthday surprises for friends
skills: reading a room and handling difficult customers
motivating and keeping hold of young staff
event planning and selling private hire
talking her way into upgrades or a better table
social media marketing for the venue
card.career_goals: Wants to move up to operations or area manager within the next couple of years, ideally with a company car and fewer weekend shifts. She sometimes daydreams about opening her own bar with a friend, although she knows she'd need someone else to do the money side. She'd like to be seen as one of the rising names in the group and have a bit of a profile locally.
card.voice: Fast, bright and chatty, with a mild Essex/South East accent: some glottal stops, 'innit' very occasionally and only jokingly, and 'like' and 'literally' used a lot. She uses 'erm' when thinking and 'sort of' and 'kind of' as hedges, about equally. She tags sentences with 'yeah?' and 'do you know what I mean?' and calls the evening meal 'dinner'. She says 'I'm knackered' and 'I was well chuffed'. She echoes the interviewer's words back and builds on them, and laughs easily. She doesn't sit in silence well and will fill a pause with a story or a joke, sometimes answering a slightly different question than the one asked. She says 'sorry, what was that?' if the line drops, and uses an ironic 'sorry' when she's mid-rant.
card.typing: Quick and casual. Mostly lower case with the occasional capital at the start. Apostrophes are hit and miss ('dont', 'im', but 'it's' sometimes). She uses 'lol', 'tbh', 'x' out of habit even in forms, and 'sooo' with extra letters. Commas are sparse, she ends with no full stop or with '!!', and she makes the odd autocorrect slip she doesn't fix.
card.with_strangers: Instantly friendly and makes you feel like you've known her for ages. She asks you questions back, compliments you, and finds something in common within a minute. She is a bit of a performer and likes to come across as successful and fun, so she'll mention being a GM fairly early. She is warm and agreeable, rarely disagrees outright, and is happy to chat well past the point she needs to.
small_things: Biscuit the cockapoo chewing her trainers
how knackered she is after a Saturday double
a new bar opening in town she wants to check out
trying to get her nails done before a wedding
a staff member who keeps calling in sick
planning a friend's hen do in Marbella
deeper_things: She feels pressure from her mum and mother-in-law about when they're having kids, and isn't sure she wants them yet
She sometimes worries she got promoted on personality and that people will notice how disorganised she is
She left out on applications that her degree was a 2:2 and tends to blur that when asked
The long hours mean she and Ryan sometimes go days barely seeing each other, and that gets to her
She spends more than she earns on clothes and nights out and has a credit card Ryan doesn't fully know about
She would love to be properly respected in the industry, not just liked
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at a slight upward angle, framing her from mid-chest up, slightly off-centre to the left. Warm late-afternoon light comes from a window to her right, so the right side of her face is brighter. She is a white woman in her late twenties with a full, smiling face, mid-laugh, eyes slightly crinkled, and lightly tanned skin with full makeup: defined brows, lashes and a nude lip. She has long honey-blonde balayage hair, loosely curled, worn down over one shoulder, and small gold hoop earrings. No glasses. She is wearing a fitted black ribbed top with a thin gold necklace. Behind her is a light grey fabric sofa with a cream bouclé cushion and a mustard throw, a white wall with a large framed black-and-white print of their wedding day, and a round mirror with a gold rim. A trailing pothos sits on a wooden shelf alongside a reed diffuser and a candle. The tail of a beige cockapoo is just visible on the sofa edge at the bottom right.
